name: Archimeda Risk Lab
description: Independent synthetic payment-risk research with reproducible modeling, complete-path replay and field governance.
description_good_justification: Research purpose, input assumptions and limits are documented. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: Issues and pull-request process, expectations and test commands are documented. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: Contribution process covers proposals, implementation, evidence and maintainer review. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: Coding, testing, provenance, licensing and AI disclosure requirements are explicit. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
floss_license_justification: Independent project code and synthetic data use the MIT license; third-party licenses remain separate. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/LICENSE
license_location_justification: License text is in the repository root. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/LICENSE
repo_public_justification: This is a public Git repository; public API and anonymous access have been verified. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/README.md
release_notes_justification: Existing releases and their changes are described; no new software version is fabricated for this assessment. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

static_analysis_justification: Bandit 1.8.6 scans all Python application/delivery sources in actual CI, beyond compiler warnings. JS/SQL are outside its scope. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/docs/PUBLICATION_QUALITY.json
dynamic_analysis_justification: Not attested for this application. A specific review, history check, missing implementation or owner confirmation is still required; absence of evidence is not converted into Met.
documentation_basics_justification: Installation, commands, research topics, methods and limitations are documented. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/README.md
sites_https_justification: Repository, Pages and release delivery use HTTPS; public URLs were actually verified. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/README.md
discussion_justification: Public GitHub issues and pull requests provide searchable discussions with stable URLs. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
maintained_justification: The public repository is actively maintained through dated commits and verified PRs; this does not assert a long maintenance history. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CHECKPOINT.md
repo_track_justification: Git commit history records changes, authors and dates; public pull requests preserve reviewable diffs. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
repo_interim_justification: Interim development commits and PR branches are public; the repository is not a release-only dump. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
repo_distributed_justification: Source is maintained in Git, a distributed version-control system. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/README.md
version_unique_justification: Published software and protocol milestones have distinct tags and release records; daily changes are identified by immutable commits. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
version_tags_justification: Existing Git tags identify the software RC and delivery milestone; no new tag is fabricated for this application. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
report_process_justification: The contribution guide explains submitting minimal reproducible bug reports through GitHub Issues. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues is the public individual-issue tracker. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
report_archive_justification: Public Issues and PRs retain searchable reports and responses; no prior response history is fabricated. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The security policy explains private vulnerability reporting, scope and coordinated disclosure. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting was enabled and its enabled=true API state verified. The policy links the private form. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/SECURITY.md
build_justification: setuptools/pip builds the Python distribution from source; isolated installation and outputs were actually verified. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/docs/RC1_REPRODUCTION.json
build_common_tools_justification: The build uses standard Python setuptools/pip with pyproject metadata. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/pyproject.toml
build_floss_tools_justification: Local building uses FLOSS Python, setuptools and pip. Hosted GitHub services are not required to build locally. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/docs/licenses.md
test_justification: Public MIT-licensed unittest suite runs on Linux Python 3.9 and 3.11; new regression tests preserve negative cases. Accepted baselines and scope are documented. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/docs/PUBLICATION_ASSESSMENTS.md
test_invocation_justification: The suite uses the standard python -m unittest discover command. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Push and PR CI execute actual behavioral tests on Linux Python 3.9 and 3.11. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
test_policy_justification: Major functionality and fixes require behavioral tests and failure examples, not weakened assertions. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
tests_are_added_justification: Recent incremental-history and validation-scope functionality added tests for deleted secrets, divergent baselines, symlinks and reverted research changes. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/tests/test_maintenance.py
tests_documented_added_justification: Contribution instructions document adding relevant tests for code and research changes. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
warnings_justification: Python test and research execution use -W error so applicable Python warnings are fatal; this is not an application static-security analysis claim. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
warnings_fixed_justification: The tested Python paths passed with warnings treated as errors. This does not claim unexecuted paths have no problems. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
warnings_strict_justification: CI runs python -W error; warnings are not suppressed to manufacture passing tests. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
crypto_published_justification: Published SHA-256 is used for artifact integrity; no custom cryptographic algorithm is implemented. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/scripts/audit_release.py
crypto_call_justification: Integrity hashing calls the Python standard hashlib library instead of implementing cryptographic primitives. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/scripts/audit_release.py
crypto_floss_justification: Python hashlib and the local dependencies are FLOSS; no proprietary cryptographic implementation is required. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/docs/licenses.md
delivery_mitm_justification: Canonical source, Pages and release assets are delivered over HTTPS; verified public delivery records are retained. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/README.md
delivery_unsigned_justification: Official delivery verification requires HTTPS Pages; no digest obtained via plain HTTP is used as a trusted release verification source. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/scripts/verify_publication.py
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Runtime tests execute unittest assertions and validation scripts with Python optimization disabled (no -O); this does not claim a separate dynamic-security analyzer. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/.github/workflows/check.yml
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The project itself produces Python, JavaScript and SQL code, not C/C++ or another memory-unsafe language. Native third-party numerical dependencies remain separately maintained. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/pyproject.toml
documentation_interface_justification: Public CLI commands, inputs, outputs, compatibility and failures documented. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/docs/PUBLICATION_ENGLISH_GUIDE.md
english_justification: English interface/reproduction guide and CLI help are available; English issues and PRs are explicitly welcome. https://github.com/ArchimeDAs0612/archimeda-risk-lab/blob/main/docs/PUBLICATION_ENGLISH_GUIDE.md
